description: This file defines an interface 'IClusterConnectionStatusObserver' in the Orleans namespace, which provides methods for receiving notifications about the status of a cluster connection, including gateway count changes and connection loss.

classes.name: IClusterConnectionStatusObserver
classes.description: Interface for observing cluster connection status changes, including gateway count updates and connection loss notifications.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies the observer that the number of connected gateways has changed, providing current and previous counts, and whether the connection was recovered.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies the observer that the connection to the cluster has been lost.
